prompt: State how the velocity of an object can be determined from its displacement-time graph.

mark_scheme.criterion: gradient of the line (or gradient of the tangent to the curve)

hints: Think about what mathematical property of the graph gives rate of change.
Velocity is the rate of change of displacement.
solution: The velocity is determined from the gradient of the displacement-time graph (or the gradient of the tangent to the curve).
teacher_walkthrough: Since velocity is Delta s / Delta t, velocity equals the gradient.
